logline_en: A consented series featuring one charismatic local shopkeeper's signature lines, structured as a ranked countdown with a practical 'how to visit' payoff.

evidence.claim: '남대문 스카프 주말 방문 꿀팁' — 326,193 views, 208x creator median, 21 s.
Scarf-seller hashtags only — 244,322 views, 183x creator median.
'남대문 스카프 어록 순위' — 200,485 views, 4.6x creator median; ranked-quotes format.
'남대문시장 살것들 다 사봤는데..' — 214,544 views, 15x creator median.

measured_facts: Cluster t1 (run cr_topic_20261031_f84a18f2): 6 videos from 6 different creators about the same Namdaemun scarf seller, median 77x creator baseline, 5 of 6 published in the last 7 days (2026-10-25..29).
All 6 members came from a single search path (query concentration 1.0), so the cluster's size says nothing about how widespread the phenomenon is.
hypotheses: H1: The driver is the person (a quotable, warm merchant) plus a visit-utility payoff, not the scarves; a different consenting merchant with distinctive lines can reproduce part of the effect.
H2: A ranked 'top 5 lines' structure holds viewers to the end better than a single-clip format (avg view % above account median).
H3 (risk): the effect is specific to this one person and will not transfer — treat the first episode as a test.
why_now: Independent creators converged on one real-world character within a week (emerging: 5 of 6 videos in the last 7 days). Caveat: query echo; one collection day; metadata only.
creative_principle: A real, consenting local character + quotable lines + a ranking device + a concrete reason to visit.
originality_notes: We do not film or reuse the Namdaemun seller or any source footage; we film a different merchant who signs a release and approves the final cut.
format: documentary-style vertical, ranked quotes, on-camera merchant with captions

edit_plan: Countdown 5→1 with the strongest line last; cut each quote to its punchline; captions on every line.
audio_plan: Natural on-site sound, lav mic on the merchant; light bed under transitions only; -14 LUFS.
success_metric: Views above account median and comments mentioning a visit; if below median after 2 episodes, retire H1.
risks: Consent and portrayal must be approved by the merchant
